'''''Millanti''''' was the [[YV-666 light freighter/Legends|YV-666 light freighter]] owned by husband and wife [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Ohwun De Maal/Legends|Ohwun]] and [[Chachi De Maal/Legends|Chachi De Maal]]. The ship had over a dozen secret cargo holds, and was known to have been used by the couple to smuggle [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="POTJ">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Power of the Jedi|pack=Ellorrs Madak|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/potjduro.asp}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The "Jedi Force File" pamphlet from Hasbro's ''[[Star Wars: Power of the Jedi]]'' toy line "Ellors Madak" (an alias of De Maal) action figure used a modified image of the [[Hound's Tooth/Legends|''Hound's Tooth'']] from the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'s [[Dagobah Limited]] expansion set to represent the ''Millanti''.<ref name="POTJ" />
